book.name: Lukas
book.title: Xoulek Nimza wei Lukas byex o

content: Yesu taxe xel betiyeing tiwei myaxeeng o
Bouk ti eno Yesu la nale wou lounyeing Genesaret
nenyawes, me xomaxoneing ngenong la vingama e vivekwou e, me di ngo Anutu xe xoulek.
Yesu yei bot yayuw di yeip wou lounyeing nenyawes, xel wei mi qou woing eno la veil, en xel la di sekweyexe xel xe lewek.
Yesu lek la eivek bot ti, tiyon Simon xe, me teling wou Simon bei e tendu bot na nayaka veil lounyeing nenyawes. Woyom la dei lek bot me teyoxe xel ngenongakes on.
Gyeik ingwei e neil xoulek woy, eno neil wou Simon bei, “Tendu bot e la eivek memiing manghembi me nex lewek teila eivek en kandek na puw woing o.”
Simon lewexe bei, “Teiv, boukeing tine xa wong xuk ngandoung ek xa se qou lulti. Ekom wang neil, om tyek a nox banex lewek na eivek memiing no.”
Gyeik xel wong ambei nyon eno woing ngenong eivek me lewek embei tax.

Om xel nex memend en xel wei xel xouing mi wong xuk lekti wei toundei lek bot nge yo me xel lam vind xel me toung woing eivek bot luw xouing me e puplek om wong bot luw xouing di teila eivek memiing lalei.
Gyeik ingwei Simon Petele yei inyon, eno la ev vaxa qatu eivek wou Yesu me neil embei, “Tambiy Ngandoung, la veil ay, en a moux wei sewokeing o.”
En e is liyeiw dalus wei toundei is e eno etek en ingwei xel qou woing ngenong o.

Me Sebedi neu Jems aluw Yoan wei luw mi wong xuk woing is Simon, eno luw yei me etek is. Woyom Yesu neil wou Simon bei, “Wa seng gwaleeng. En gweimbeeng me e mi na eno tyek wang bong xuk me na qou xomaxoneing.”
Om xel puw xel xe bot luw xouing la nale yasewis, woyom xel ghanaw lulul dalus toundei de la betiwou Yesu.
Moux wei vanei lepa yo

Ka Yesu toundei eivek beyeeng ti, eno tambiy ti lam, ninavi pup en vanei lepa. Gyeik ingwei yei Yesu, moxo yeip ma eivek tembuing wou e me tay wou e, “Tambiy Ngandoung, wangwei wa laleim devind ond wang bong am bo nimzalek.”
Yesu tatei mema la me axlek moux tiyon. Moxo neil embei, “A laleing vind, wang bo nimzalek!” De lutika eno lepa ma veil e.
Woyom Yesu luk nikanzek wou embei, “Wa se neil wou xelti, qe la, me talex xow wou lumuki, me ghe bong xound na nambei Mose neil o en e talex bei wang wo nimzalek, en xel boulek bei wa xe vanei ma.”
De pavulek wei Yesu eno la wo ngandoung, om xomaxoneing ngenong lam me ngo e de moxo wong xel xe vanei wo nimzalek.
Ekom Yesu venaxow mi la veil xel me la tembuing bandaing me la zeimema.
Yesu wong tambiy wei bezomb o wo nimzalek
Bouk ti gyeik Yesu di teyoxe moux alis vex me dei, eno xel Parisi

me xel putoung wei petieing eno xel lam anghei beyeeng dalus wei Galili me Yudia me beyeeng Yerusalem, me la toundei inyei. Me Tambiy Ngandoung xe nikanzek lam eivek Yesu me e wong moux alis vex xe vanei wo nimzalek.
Xel moux valu qalei tambiy wei bezomb o ti lek lelek me lam, xel di wong me yei en xel embei qou e me na xomek lalei me na niw wou Yesu ma.

Gyeik ingwei xel lam eno xel ngenongakes toundei zeyi om xel se teyeimbei gyeiwou sakwaing ti me na eivek xomek lalei. Om xel lek xomek demi qetyei me gwang danghei ti me byex yis lek lelek me wong tambiy on di teila kaka eivek moux alis vex senghoing wou Yesu ma.
Gyeik ingwei Yesu yei xel xe wongeingis, moxo neil embei, “Gweleeng, a semaleeng wa xe sewokeing.”
Xel Parisi me xel putoung wei petieing o di wou eivek naleind, “Eti ingwei embei qou Anutu nimbeeng nei? Xelti se teyeimbei semaleeng sewokeing, qe Anutu venaxow.”
Yesu woulek vati wei xel di wou naleind en o me teling, “Nambei nya xam ghe di wou naleimim en lulti beimambei ne eivek laleimim?
Qayeeng vati teyei bei neileing, ‘A semaleeng wa xe sewokeing’ o neileing bei, ‘Wa qandi lek me ghe na?’

Ekom inyon xam ghe boulek bei Xomaxoneing Neu Moux qou lei ngandoung lek tembuing en embei semaleeng sewokeing.” Moxo neil wou moux ti bezombeing on, “A neil wou wang, qandi lek, qou wa xe lelek me la bam.”
Lutika eno moxo qandi lek wou moux alis vex mend me qou e xe vati wei yeip lek o me la beeng de di sanghoxe Anutu.
Xomaxoneing dalus etek en ingwei xel yei Anutu xe nikanzek me poux zeng, de sanghoxe Anutu me neil embei, “Xey a xei lulvako ngandoung gweimbeeng.”
Yesu taxe Livai
Ka tine la veil eno Yesu la myayaing me yei tambiy wei mi qou takis o ti lei Livai eno toundei eivek xomek takis. Yesu neil wou bei, “Wa betiy ay.”
Livai qandi lek me ghanaw lulul dalus de betiwou e.
Woyom Livai wong mata ngandoung ti wou Yesu eivek xomek wei e nei me xel qendu ngandoung wei mi qou takis o me xel valu lam ya is xel.
Ekom xel Parisi me xel putoung wei petieing o eivek qendu wei Parisi yo di neil Yesu xe xel betiyeing, “Nambei nya xam ghe di wa me ghe num is xel wei mi qou takis me xel wei sewokeing o?”
Yesu lewexe me neil embei, “Xel wei vanei ma eno se mi la wou dokta, qe xel wei vanei yo.
A se lam bei taxe xel wei bombek o, qe xel wei sewokeing o en xel pekwi xow.”
Xel teling Yesu en kwa wei vambueing yaeing o
De xel neil wou embei, “Xel betiyeing wei Yoan o di vambu yaeing me zeimemend me xel betiyeing wei Parisi yo is, ekom ingwei wang eno di wo eisanou lek yaeing me numeing.”
Yesu lewexe bei, “Wang teyei bei bong xel wei lam toundei is tambiy wei embei dii vex eno vambu yaeing gyeik e toundei is xel o?
Ekom bouk tyek nam gyeik ingwei xel a qou tambiy tiwei embei dii vex eno me na veil xel, on tyek eivek bouk kayon eno xel vambu yaeing.”

Me Yesu neil qayeeng pakeing tine wou xel bei, “Xelti se mi qateiv teimb ding myasepu wei vako yo me duw eivek ingwei takwei yo. Wangwei e bong ambei nyon, on tyek zex teimb ding wei vako yo, de ing vako eno tyek se ghok ingwei takwei yo.
Me xelti se mi taw wain nilouk vako eivek wain takwei ninavi
. Wangwei e bong ambei nyon on tyek wain vako zex wain ninavi, de wain tyek na taw veil de wain ninavi zex me bo nol.
Ma, xel a taw wain vako eivek wain ninavi vako.
Me xel tiwei num wain takwei eno tyek laleind se devind bei na num vako, en tyek na neimbei, ‘Takwei nimza.’”

footnotes.text: Parisi xel wei mi betiwou xel xe kwa me Mose xe petieing.
wain takwei ninavi Xel mi duw sipsip me meme ninavi me taw wain nilouk me memiing eivek.
